completion_criteria.text: Detailed SPEC authored in a fresh session and user-approved, covering archive layout, per-thread v2 seeding, and plugin install/setup

Plugin skills renamed session-handoff -> ledgerize and resume-project -> lift-off, published, and continuity-ledger.md updated in lockstep AND committed
Every non-terminal v1 thread carried into v2 as a NEW hand-authored thread preserving work done and work remaining, pointing at the archive, parked at its correct status

spine.active_goal: Retire the v1 file ledger by freezing it as a grep-only archive and standing v2 up fresh. Archive move DONE and verified 2026-07-26; 7 v2 threads seeded; index rebuilt. Only the live-plugin half of criterion 5 remains.
spine.next_step: Re-install the plugin to pick up the published fix 0fe1c02 (currently installed at the PRE-fix 3b9de99), then RESTART Claude Code a second time, then run a live /lift-off to confirm it presents the 7 seeded threads. The live /ledgerize half was already exercised on 2026-07-26 against the pre-fix plugin and wrote correctly. That closes criterion 5.
open_risks: The installed plugin is still the PRE-fix 3b9de99. Picking up 0fe1c02 needs a marketplace/plugin update AND a second restart. The guard message still printing `mcp__ledger__*` is the cheap way to confirm which build is live.

HOOK-MATCHER FIX STILL BLOCKED, fully specified, zero technical unknowns: hooks/hooks.json:5 and hooks/lib/pre-tool-use.mjs:50 match only `mcp__ledger__`, so the plugin never auto-approves its own tools under plugin install. Needs the user to approve the edit directly.
The plugin's PreToolUse guard blocks even READ-ONLY shell commands touching the store. Verify the store through the MCP tools, not the shell.
Spine list items are capped at 300 chars each; an over-cap item rejects the WHOLE update_thread call rather than truncating.

Live tool names are `mcp__plugin_session-continuity_ledger__*`. Never re-use the old `mcp__ledger__*` ToolSearch check to test whether the server is loaded - it false-negatives even when the server IS running.
Store content becomes pushable once v2 lands; never run `ledger-cli sync` without a fresh foreign-token scan.
`chmod -R a-w` is an accident guardrail, not tamper resistance. Never call the freeze immutable. `.git/info/exclude` is clone-local; a fresh clone is protected only by .claude/.gitignore:42.
Three v1 threads were deliberately NOT carried into v2 (decision 0002). Their open items exist ONLY in the frozen archive and nothing will surface them at resume.
bindings / by_branch are 0 - vcs_ref is stored per thread but bind_branch was never called, so branch-based lookup will not resolve.
Chained multi-command Bash calls get denied; issue git operations atomically.
